candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (~2s ReadTimeout), causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502; inventory/redis path is healthy.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show client-side ReadTimeout on payment; no payment-side metrics/logs to confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable.

report.explanation: All failing checkout traces share a POST payment transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis reservations succeed; gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Bounded to downstream payment latency/timeout.
